name: create_case
description: Create a case so an officer calls the caller back. Use when the caller asks for a person, sounds distressed, mentions a risk to health or safety, or when a tool keeps failing. Then tell the caller an officer will call back. Use type identity_concern as soon as the caller says they are not the person who was verified, or are acting for someone else: this holds the call so nothing more can be changed.

type.description: Short topic, for example bins, council_tax, permit, residency, refund, identity_concern, general

priority.description: urgent for risk to health or safety, otherwise routine

summary.description: Two or three sentences so the officer does not need to ask again
